scope: I02-I08 one bounded scalar adjudication per complete case block; prospective before any G source or RG review is scored
protected_agreement: Every field on which both structurally valid independent reviewers agree is frozen exactly. Evidence prose may differ. Identity/fixed fields never adjudicated.
family_rule: archive_pairs.relation, candidate_pairs.relation, raw_rows.novelty and raw_rows.family_confirmed are family judgments. Differences remain unresolved; no scalar adjudication, no forced merging.
scalar_rule: Other non-identity, non-fixed, non-evidence grades from the exact packet matrix may be independently adjudicated only when reviewers differ. Values must use original enums/types; explicit unresolved is permitted.

resolutions.value: original typed allowed scalar, or null if unresolved

call_and_word_budget.prospective_basis: No more source semantic fields than the already capacity-tested 210-row main review. Preserve full coverage; actual burden reported. Original per-case scalar call maximum unchanged.

failure_rule: Missing/invalid independent review gates whole raw comparison; no adjudication replaces it. Invalid/missing adjudication leaves all disputed scalars unresolved. Planned sources retained with null assessments, never zero novelty.
authority_ceiling: Native assessments of stipulated synthetic cases. No physical, operational or human decision outcome is inferred.
